purpose: Teach: カーソル/落合/錬金術/色気/ポルシェ/初恋/川柳/バッシング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがワープロのカーソル操作で苦労された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he struggled so much with the wordprocessor controls…
lines.style: Gentle, searching tone. Soft pause before the main thought, as if reaching back through time. Warm but slightly uncertain, like a quiet memory being confirmed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、落合監督の試合をご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—and your grandfather, he used to watch the Ochiai manager's matches, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing affection. Light touch of teasing. Quick-paced, animated. The rhythm of someone finishing a familiar duet with her husband.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが錬金術の本に夢中だった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was completely absorbed in those alchemy books…
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. Slight exhale at the opening. Slower pace. The voice of someone surfacing from a private memory, speaking half to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、母さんの色気にやられたんだって?
lines.en: Your grandfather, when he was young—he fell hard for your grandmother's charm, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright, playful tease with underlying warmth. A knowing smile in the voice. Gentle and direct, no malice. The rhythm of someone calling her husband out with love.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがポルシェの本をお買いになった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he bought himself that Porsche book…
lines.style: Quieter this time, almost amused by the memory. Slow delivery. Understated fondness. The voice of someone who has carried this small detail for decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、初恋のお話を聞かせて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, you told me about your first love once, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warmth with a slight challenge underneath. Inviting, but with gentle persistence. Medium pace. The voice of someone drawing her husband toward vulnerability.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが川柳をご投稿された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he submitted his senryu poems…
lines.style: Quietest yet. Almost a whisper. Fond. Slight trailing-off. The voice of someone honoring a small, private pride from long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、メディアのバッシングに憤慨されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, when the media tore into him—he was furious about that, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Close, intimate tone. Protective undertone. Quick, sharp attack on the accusation, then softens. The voice of someone who remembers his anger and holds it with care.
